# Tomoz

> Tomoz is a calendar planner for iPhone that shows tomorrow's events, and optionally your reminders, in one clean preview so you can plan the night before.

Available now on the App Store.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18.5 or later
- Price: free to download; the optional Reminders add-on is a one-time £1.99 in-app purchase
- Privacy: calendar and Reminders data stays on the device and is never sent to a server
- Developer: Mat Benfield (thechelsuk), made in the UK

## Links

- [Tomoz website](https://tomoz.thechels.uk/): the official marketing site
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/tomoz/id6748755747): download the app
- [Privacy policy](https://thechels.uk/app/privacy): what the app does and does not collect
- [Project page](https://thechels.uk/projects/tomoz): background from the developer

## Features

- Preview tomorrow's events from the calendars you choose
- Colour-code calendars to see what's what at a glance
- Optional Reminders add-on shows tasks alongside events
- Export as Markdown, JSON or CSV
- Spoken summary with Siri and automation with Apple Shortcuts

## FAQ

### What does Tomoz do?

Tomoz shows a clean preview of tomorrow's calendar events so you can plan the night before instead of scrambling in the morning.

### Does it show my reminders too?

Yes. With the optional Reminders add-on, a one-time £1.99 in-app purchase, your tasks appear alongside tomorrow's events.

### Can I export my plan?

Yes. Export as Markdown, JSON or CSV, ask Siri for a spoken summary, or automate exports with Apple Shortcuts.

### Is my calendar data private?

Yes. Your calendar and Reminders data stays on your device and is never sent to a server.

### Which devices are supported?

iPhone running iOS 18.5 or later.
